name: Inamoto Hatsune
source:
The wife/mother/daughter/sister of the protagonist (depending on what cheats are or aren't used). Can also be a catgirl, cowgirl, pirate or a combination of the three depending on what cheats are activated.

[spoiler]If she is [url=https://vndb.org/c62195]Minorou[/url]'s sister, they lost their virginities together long time ago when Hatsune had her two arms broken and when they were teenagers.[/spoiler]
